strategy_roster.name: MACD Slope Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: The documented MACD 12/26/9 line is differenced over SlopePeriod 20 to form a slope, which must exceed its own 20-bar mean by the BreakoutMultiplier 2.0 standard deviations; exit is reversion to that mean. The documented StopLossPercent 2.0 is the one protection that maps to a percentage field, and the 5-minute timeframe is not configurable here.

strategy_roster.name: Directed Movement
strategy_roster.notes: The twice-smoothed RSI is rebuilt as an RSI(14) smoothed once by SMA(3) and again by SMA(6), and the documented contrarian buy on a downward cross of the fast line is used literally. RsiPeriod, FirstMaLength and SecondMaLength have no documented values so 14/3/6 are explicit defaults, and StopLossPercent/TakeProfitPercent are also undocumented so no percentage is set.

strategy_roster.name: Bollinger Breakout Momentum
strategy_roster.entry_long: (bb_upper(close,18,2) - bb_lower(close,18,2)) / bb_mid(close,18) > 0.0015 and macd(close,12,26) > 0 and rsi(close,14) > 50 and ema(close,21) > bb_mid(close,18) and close > bb_upper(close,18,2)
strategy_roster.notes: Documented BollingerLength 18, deviation 2 and BreakoutFactor 0.0015 (applied to relative band width) are kept, with MACD>0, RSI>50, an EMA above the middle band and a close beyond the upper band; the previous-bar version of that close is approximated by the current one. The trailing middle-band stop becomes the exit and the 100-pip take profit is not a percentage field.

strategy_roster.name: Forex Profit Boost
strategy_roster.notes: Documented FastPeriod 7 (EMA) and SlowPeriod 21 (SMA) are used, and the reversal rule means the long is entered when the fast EMA crosses below the slow SMA. The 1000/2000 price-point stop and target are absolute distances and are left null.

strategy_roster.name: Swing High Low Pivots Strategy [LV]
strategy_roster.notes: A long limit at a confirmed pivot low becomes price touching the prior 3-bar low (pivot length 3 is an explicit default) with the moving-average filter permitting longs; the filter crossing back is the exit. Fixed stop and the two take-profit targets are tick distances, and pending-order placement plus the double-entry switch are order features.

strategy_roster.name: Cidomo
strategy_roster.notes: The documented BarsCount 15 channel becomes a prior 15-bar high/low, with the 3-pip IndentPips approximated by a 0.1% offset and the mirrored break as the exit. StopLossPips/TakeProfitPips 50, the 35/5 stepped trail, the +/-30-second order window and both money-management modes are pip, clock and position features.

strategy_roster.name: Order Stabilization
strategy_roster.notes: The paired stop orders around the current price are represented by a break above the prior bar's high with the OrderDistancePoints 20 buffer approximated as 0.2%, and the stabilisation exit by price falling back under its 5-period mean. StabilizationPoints 25, AbsoluteFixation 30, ProfitThreshold -2 and the 20-minute order expiry are point or currency values.

strategy_roster.name: Amstell Grid
strategy_roster.notes: The engine cannot run a hedged two-sided grid, so the long ladder is approximated as successive buys at a level about 1% below the mean (a percentage stand-in for StepPips 15) closing on the return to that mean, which is the virtual TakeProfitPips 50 objective. Separate long/short stacks, per-entry virtual targets and last-deal-price bookkeeping are position state.

strategy_roster.name: Breakdown Pending Stop
strategy_roster.notes: Pending stop orders around the previous session range become breaks of the prior bar's high and low, with Min Distance treated as zero. Stop-loss, take-profit, trailing and trailing-step values are all tick distances, and the per-session order refresh needs a clock.

strategy_roster.name: Short-Term Reversal Stocks
strategy_roster.notes: The documented one-week loser ranking has no cross-section in a single series, so a large negative 5-day return stands in for being bought as a laggard, with the exit when the week turns positive. -8% is an explicit default, the few-day holding period is not fixed, and the optional volatility stop has no documented value.
